subject.title: Telegram: specific forum topic becomes permanent inbound black hole after stuck-session recovery

question: Should the Telegram reliability work be scoped to a narrow lane-release repair first, or sponsored as a broader durable-ingress contract covering acknowledged-but-undispatched updates across forum topics and direct messages?
rationale: The reports support a real loss symptom, but they do not yet prove whether the guarded-lane mechanism and the restart-persistent routing failure share one state owner; the recovery boundary determines the correct implementation and validation scope.

options.title: Sponsor durable ingress recovery
options.body: Define an acknowledged-update persistence and recoverability contract across Telegram lanes, including forum topics, and investigate the shared loss signature.

options.title: Land a narrow guarded-lane repair
options.body: Address only the confirmed in-process timeout guard and retain this issue for restart-persistent routing evidence.

options.title: Request focused live captures first
options.body: Require a fresh current-version trace correlating update offset, spool, lane state, and session routing before selecting the repair boundary.

recommendation.title: Sponsor durable ingress recovery
recommendation.body: Define an acknowledged-update persistence and recoverability contract across Telegram lanes, including forum topics, and investigate the shared loss signature.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the closest documented investigation of the relevant polling-lane recovery path, though current-main ownership still needs confirmation.
